sentences.s: 汤姆拐弯儿拐得太快了，把车开到了水沟里。
sentences.t: 湯姆拐彎兒拐得太快了，把車開到了水溝裏。
sentences.en: Tom was driving too fast on the corner and ended up in the ditch.

sentences.s: 我现在唯一想做的事情是睡觉。
sentences.t: 我現在唯一想做的事情是睡覺。
sentences.en: The only thing I want to do right now is sleep.

sentences.s: 我不能让汤姆这么轻易杀了我。
sentences.t: 我不能讓湯姆這麼輕易殺了我。
sentences.en: I can't just let Tom kill me.

sentences.s: 我必须仔细做。
sentences.t: 我必須仔細做。
sentences.en: I must do that carefully.

sentences.s: 他打量了我一番，到嘴边的话又不说了。
sentences.t: 他打量了我一番，到嘴邊的話又不說了。
sentences.en: He sized me up (once over) and swallowed his words. (Lit. [As for] the words that [came] to the edge of his mouth, he [changed his mind] again and didn’t utter them.)

sentences.s: 她又犯了同样的错误了。
sentences.t: 她又犯了同樣的錯誤了。
sentences.en: She made the same mistake again.

sentences.s: 我熟悉这个主题。
sentences.t: 我熟悉這個主題。
sentences.en: I am familiar with this subject.

sentences.s: 我们每个学期都要至少参加三次义务劳动。
sentences.t: 我們每個學期都要至少參加三次義務勞動。
sentences.en: We must participate in at least three compulsory labor per semester.

source.title: 义务
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 她将会工作。
sentences.t: 她將會工作。
sentences.en: She will work.

sentences.s: 那两个人偷偷溜进了房子里，给人看见了。
sentences.t: 那兩個人偷偷溜進了房子裏，給人看見了。
sentences.en: The two men were seen to steal into the house.

sentences.s: 我深爱我的祖国。
sentences.t: 我深愛我的祖國。
sentences.en: I love my country with every fiber of my being.

sentences.s: 今天是中秋节。
sentences.t: 今天是中秋節。
sentences.en: Today is the Mid-Autumn Festival.

sentences.s: 你和你哥哥长得一模一样。
sentences.t: 你和你哥哥長得一模一樣。
sentences.en: You look just like your big brother.

sentences.s: 除非有人跟他说话，他不说话。
sentences.t: 除非有人跟他說話，他不說話。
sentences.en: He did not speak unless spoken to.

sentences.s: 你会讲法语吗？
sentences.t: 你會講法語嗎？
sentences.en: Can you speak French?

sentences.s: 您是在这儿用餐，还是给您打包带走？
sentences.t: 您是在這兒用餐，還是給您打包帶走？
sentences.en: Are you going to eat here or do you want us to wrap it?

sentences.s: 这钱就算我借给你的，将来你有了的时候再还我。
sentences.t: 這錢就算我借給你的，將來你有了的時候再還我。
sentences.en: Let’s just say that the money is loaned to you, you can pay me back when you have [more money].

source.title: 算
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 她倒车进车库。
sentences.t: 她倒車進車庫。
sentences.en: She backed her car into the garage.

sentences.s: 旅行是令人快乐的。
sentences.t: 旅行是令人快樂的。
sentences.en: It's fun to travel.

sentences.s: 一位老人打断了我们的谈话。
sentences.t: 一位老人打斷了我們的談話。
sentences.en: An old man broke into our conversation.

sentences.s: 这就是我出生的村庄。
sentences.t: 這就是我出生的村莊。
sentences.en: That's the village I was born in.

sentences.s: 我周日从不在家。
sentences.t: 我週日從不在家。
sentences.en: I'm never at home on Sundays.

sentences.s: 我不知道是不是所有机器人都这么懒。
sentences.t: 我不知道是不是所有機器人都這麼懶。
sentences.en: I am not sure if all the robots are so lazy.

sentences.s: 他会想办法的，你就别替他瞎担心了。
sentences.t: 他會想辦法的，你就別替他瞎擔心了。
sentences.en: He will find a way, you don't (thoughtlessly) worry about him.

source.title: 瞎
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我来这个镇有十年了。
sentences.t: 我來這個鎮有十年了。
sentences.en: It's been ten years since I came to this town.

sentences.s: 该死的！你吓了我一大跳！
sentences.t: 該死的！你嚇了我一大跳！
sentences.en: Shit! You scared me half to death!

sentences.s: 柜子上有几本书？
sentences.t: 櫃子上有幾本書？
sentences.en: How many books are on the shelf?

sentences.s: 我们回来时，立刻感受到了家的温暖。
sentences.t: 我們回來時，立刻感受到了家的溫暖。
sentences.en: When we came back, we immediately felt the warmth of home.

source.title: 立刻
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 你的领带不错。
sentences.t: 你的領帶不錯。
sentences.en: Your tie looks good.

sentences.s: 请尽可能慢点说。
sentences.t: 請儘可能慢點說。
sentences.en: Please speak as slowly as possible.

sentences.s: 我们在夏威夷一年到头都可以享受在海里游泳的乐趣。
sentences.t: 我們在夏威夷一年到頭都可以享受在海里游泳的樂趣。
sentences.en: In Hawaii, we can enjoy swimming in the ocean all year round.

sentences.s: 你的眼睛跟大熊猫一样。
sentences.t: 你的眼睛跟大熊貓一樣。
sentences.en: Your eyes are like pandas’ [eyes].

source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 这个人办事，别提多负责了。
sentences.t: 這個人辦事，別提多負責了。
sentences.en: This person does things, don't mention more responsibility.

source.title: 别提多……了
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我想讲法语。
sentences.t: 我想講法語。
sentences.en: I want to speak French.

sentences.s: 今天的报纸上有一则非常重要的新闻。
sentences.t: 今天的報紙上有一則非常重要的新聞。
sentences.en: There is a very important news in today's newspaper.

source.title: # 则
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 加利福尼亚发现了金矿。
sentences.t: 加利福尼亞發現了金礦。
sentences.en: Gold had been discovered in California.

sentences.s: 我加入了空军。
sentences.t: 我加入了空軍。
sentences.en: I went into the air force.

sentences.s: 这个岛从远方看起来像一片云。
sentences.t: 這個島從遠方看起來像一片雲。
sentences.en: Viewed from a distance, the island looked like a cloud.

sentences.s: 她们拒绝融入。
sentences.t: 她們拒絕融入。
sentences.en: They refuse to integrate.

sentences.s: 早安，师傅。我应该怎么样提高听力能力？
sentences.t: 早安，師傅。我應該怎麼樣提高聽力能力？
sentences.en: Good day, lords. In what way can I refine upon my adroitness in aural comprehension?

sentences.s: 他尝试了许多不同的方法。
sentences.t: 他嘗試了許多不同的方法。
sentences.en: He tried many different methods.

sentences.s: 在墙上写“某某到此一游”的行为是不文明的。
sentences.t: 在牆上寫“某某到此一遊”的行爲是不文明的。
sentences.en: It is not civil to write “so-and-so visited here” on the wall.

sentences.s: 跟别人谈论起军事来，没有人说得过他。
sentences.t: 跟別人談論起軍事來，沒有人說得過他。
sentences.en: Talking to others about military affairs, no one can win arguments (lit. talk) over him.

绝.m: to cut short; extinct; to disappear; to vanish

融.m: to melt; to thaw; to blend; to merge

安.m: surname An; (bound form) calm; peaceful; to calm; to set at ease; safe; secure; in good health

傅.m: surname Fu; (bound form) instructor; (literary) to instruct; to attach

试.m: to test; to try; experiment; examination

许.m: surname Xu; to allow; to permit; to promise

墙.m: wall (CL:面,堵); (slang) to block (a website) (usu. in the passive: 被墙)

写.m: to write; used in 写意

论.m: abbr. for 论语, The Analects (of Confucius); opinion; view; theory
